author: William Saville
content:
Be still,
Be quiet,
Don’t make a sound,
They will come if you speak out of turn.
Zipped lips,
Stand tall,
Listen to your elders,
Even if what they say doesn’t make sense,
Even if it goes against every fiber of your being.
If you go against the grain,
You’re the black sheep,
If you’d rather love than pray,
The devil’s keep.
Traumatized for the Dawn,
Before the day begins,
Haunted by the ghost of tomorrow,
Of tomorrow’s ”sins”.
Walk in front of the path,
Of a hidden gun,
Boom,
Better check the color of their skin,
Or the flag that they fly,
Or if their genitalia matches their face.
Better check their chromosomes too,
Or if they back the right kind of blue.
Twisted hate and twisted words,
Salute!
To the red white and blue.
If you’re not patriotic what happens is on you!
Better worship someone who may or may not have existed,
Better build all of our laws on that instead of those who are here.
But god forbid you’re queer.
You’ll be erased from history and books burned.
Wars fought for oil and financial gain,
If your heart isn’t filled with love for the Bible you’re insane.
But if you walk the line.
If you don’t speak out of turn.
If you put your hand on your heart,
Pledge allegiance to not changing a damn thing because you’ve got it MADE.
Your life may be a struggle but it was never made worse,
Just because the shade of your skin,
Or the god that you believe in,
Or the love you let in your heart that harms no one.
They say the body is a temple,
I will offer it happiness,
I will shape it and nurture it in the way that it pleases.
So that instead of being haunted by the memory of tomorrow,
I open my eyes and smile that I have one,
Because not everyone gets one.
